lines.text: Many learners say: Can you bring me to the station?
Better: Can you take me to the station?
Take! Can you take me to the station?

data.wrong: Can you bring me to the station?
data.right: Can you take me to the station?

quiz.stem: Can you ___ me to the station?

native.tip: ‘데려다주다’를 bring으로 옮기기 쉬워요. 다른 곳으로 갈 때는 보통 take! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “Can you take me to the station?”
native.caption: “Can you bring me to the station”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘데려다주다’를 bring으로 옮기기 쉬워요. 내가 있는 곳에서 다른 곳으로 갈 때는 보통 take를 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “Can you take me to the station?” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: To go to another place, we usually say take. Say “Can you take me to the station?”
en.caption: Do you say “Can you bring me to the station” in English? 😅 Bring comes toward you, so for another place we usually say “take”! “Can you take me to the station” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
